transcript: Speaker A: Beti graduation kar rahi thi... [Narrates the story of Sunita, a mother who feels guilty about not knowing English for her daughter's graduation. She uses the English Seekho app to practice 15 minutes daily, learning basic sentences and practicing with an AI coach. At the graduation, she delivers a moving speech in English, making her daughter proud. The narrator urges parents to learn English for their children's sake.] Speaker B: Install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [Click the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho, INSTALL NOW, [Disclaimer text in Hindi regarding non-affiliation and results depending on individual effort]
summary: An emotional animated story of a mother who overcomes her fear and guilt of not knowing English by practicing 15 minutes daily on the English Seekho app. She surprises her daughter by giving a proud speech in English at her college graduation. The ad encourages parents to learn English for their children's big moments and download the app.
